question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at MN as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0380c0dc7f5fcc04b0c9eef4425eb5fa4aadabeb21a0a1e742c5c888085dad51.png]
solution:
When the mirror is placed vertically to the objects/alphabets, the image formed will be laterally inverted. In other words, the **Left Hand Side** and **Right Hand Side** will interchange their positions while top and bottom will remain same.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2259bb600a785d901087431449d4e3d7f7127b38afd51737254366a06f8f6fb.png] 

Therefore, only option (4) follows this.

Hence, the correct answer is** option(4)**
